sections.content_markdown: 4. Draw the rays for object $XY$ and show the position of the image as accurately as possible (figure 9.34 a).
5. Draw the rays for object $XY$ and show the position of the image as accurately as possible (figure 9.34 b).

Choose the correct answer.
1. Where will the image of an object be when it is placed in a denser medium and looked at from a rarer medium?
a) raised upward b) gone downward
c) remained at the same place d) moved aside
Answer the questions 2 & 3 from Figure 9.35
2. What is the angle of refraction here?
a) $0^{\circ}$ b) $90^{\circ}$
c) $180^{\circ}$ d) $45^{\circ}$
3. What will happen if the angle of incidence is bigger?
a) Total internal refraction
b) Total internal reflection
c) Refraction and reflection
d) Reflection
